name: Dashtab
description: Dashtab: a fully customizable new tab dashboard — background, widgets, weather, clock, to-dos, and Google shortcuts.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' https://* http://* data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://api.openweathermap.org; font-src 'self' data:;
